final_message: Replaced tinyglobby globSync with node:fs globSync in src/register/authoring-sources.ts, packages/docs-lint/src/glob-files.ts and packages/docs-lint/src/deliverable-type.cjs. Also moved tools/lint-mermaid.mjs, tools/lint-d2.mjs (new shared tools/glob-markdown-files.mjs) and 4 test files off tinyglobby. Added unit tests (new tests/src/register/authoring-sources.test.ts, extended glob-files and deliverable-type tests). Updated the PJR-5CTM ticket's work table (row 5 done) and its results with the decisions, the package.json diff and the CHANGELOG draft. package.json and the lock were not changed. Old vs new comparisons on temp fixtures and on the repository matched except one documented change: docs-lint `**` no longer goes into symlinked directories.
handoff: Proposed package.json change (orchestrator applies after user approval): remove `"tinyglobby": "^0.2.17"` from root `dependencies` and from packages/docs-lint/package.json `dependencies`; raise packages/docs-lint `engines.node` from `>=22.13` to `>=22.17`. Then update the lock with npm install and confirm `npm audit --omit=dev` shows high 0 and moderate 0.

Executor decision: docs-lint `globFilesSync` and `rulebooksIn` no longer go into symlinked directories under `**` (tinyglobby defaulted to `followSymbolicLinks: true`; node:fs globSync does not follow). This matches the ticket's 'don't follow symlinks' requirement, and the repository has no symlinks, so check results do not change. Symlinks to files are still returned. Pinned by a test in tests/packages/docs-lint/glob-files.test.ts.

Executor decision: besides the 3 required places, moved tools/lint-mermaid.mjs, tools/lint-d2.mjs (shared tools/glob-markdown-files.mjs) and tests (exec-record-paths, scaffold, doc-index, register) off tinyglobby, so they do not depend on a transitive copy after it is removed from root `dependencies`.

Recommended extra (not in the completion criteria): packages/docs-lint/package.json still has `markdownlint-cli` at `^0.49.1` in `dependencies`, so users of the published docs-lint still get the markdown-it ReDoS (GHSA-gfr2-rv44-r23c). The root npm audit does not see it. Suggest raising it to `^0.50.0`.
Overall npm audit highs caused by picomatch (GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf) stay as waiting on upstream, because tinyglobby is still pulled in by dev tools (vitest, typescript-eslint, markdownlint-cli).

CHANGELOG draft (category: 変更) is in the ticket section 'CHANGELOG に書く事項'. It includes the Node.js >=22.17 requirement for @specdojo/docs-lint and the symlinked-directory behaviour change. CHANGELOG.md itself was not changed.
